visual_elements.description: 3D regression illustration: three red arrow axes — vertical 'Weight' (up), horizontal 'Length' (right), diagonal 'Radius' (down-left). A tilted translucent pale-yellow parallelogram plane floats in the middle, containing ~15 small blue scatter dots; several dots have short red dashed vertical lines connecting them to the plane (residuals). Two dark-red filled circles with white '?' sit on the left/bottom edges of the plane, connected by red dotted projection lines to the axes; a small red dot also appears on the Length axis.
Small pale-yellow box with thin border. Line 1: 'Model' in red bold. Line 2: 'I/P: Length, Radius' in black bold. Line 3: 'O/P: Weight' in black bold.

Larger pale-yellow box with thin border. Line 1: 'Model ( Plane)' — 'Model' in red bold italic, '( Plane)' with 'Plane' in green. Line 2: 'z = a x + b y + c' with z, a, b, c in blue and x, y in red. Line 3: 'Weight = a * Length + b * Radius + c' with 'Weight', 'Length', 'Radius' in blue italic and a, b, c in red. Line 4: 'Model Parameters : a , b , c' with 'Model Parameters' in blue italic and a, b, c in red.
Yellow circle badge with black number '6' (slide number)
